_comment: RECORDED DISPOSITION for ONE specific llvm-cov accounting signature. Read this
before changing anything here, and read livespec-console-beads-fabro-3yx.
THIS IS NOT A COVERAGE-THRESHOLD CHANGE. The line-coverage requirement is still
100% for every line llvm-cov can ATTRIBUTE to a source line. `check-coverage`
fails on a single nameable uncovered line exactly as it always did, and the
standing maintainer ruling that the coverage gate is correct and must not be
What is dispositioned is narrower: llvm-cov's own summary sometimes counts MORE
missed lines than any listing surface can name. Five surfaces were proven blind to
it (--show-missing-lines, JSON segment reconstruction, zero-count segments
intersected with the diff, the --text annotated listing, and the lcov export), and
a designed compilation-count experiment failed to move it and is recorded as
INCONCLUSIVE. An operator cannot act on a miss the tooling will not name.
The allowance below caps how many such unnameable lines may pass. It does NOT
hide a nameable one: the gate reports and fails on every line it can name, and
reports the dispositioned count loudly on every run.
reason: llvm-cov reports one missed line in console-application that no listing surface can attribute to a source line. Filed as livespec-console-beads-fabro-3yx with the full forensic record and a falsifiable prediction; the prediction's own experiment ran and was inconclusive. Authorized narrowly by the maintainer on 2026-08-02 so plan-01 milestone 2 can land as the A/B/C split, on the explicit condition that ordinary nameable misses continue to block everything.
review_when: The allowance must be REDUCED, never raised, as slices land. Raising it needs a new maintainer authorization recorded here with its own reason.
If a slice shows a NAMEABLE miss, fix it. This disposition does not apply.
If -3yx is ever explained or fixed, delete this file and restore the plain --fail-under-lines 100 invocation.
